snippet.title: Silicon Life: From Bedroom to Billion – Trailer | Build, repair and sell PCs from 1981 to 2025
snippet.description:
September 1981. A bedroom, a workbench, a dream: build a computer empire.

Buy the parts, put them together by hand at the 3D workbench, switch on: the boot beep, the green screen… and the first customer pays. Listen to the beeps to find a fault, save your best PC as a model and build it in series. More than 600 components follow the real history of hardware under parodied names (Untel, ADM, Envidia GeFarce, Macrosoft's Fenêtres 95), and the big events land on their real dates. From the bedroom to the garage, the shop, the warehouse, the factory and the tower of the business district: aim for a billion before the end of 2025.

Silicon Life: From Bedroom to Billion comes to Steam in March 2027, in English and French. Add it to your wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5536820/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer

Follow Forgeur Games on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/developer/forgeurgames

#SiliconLife #TycoonGame #IndieGame
